title: Rework workflow phases around independently reviewed behavioural tests
body:
## Outcome

Replace the current per-goal workflow phase DAG with a smaller work-phase model whose phase-specific reviews are selected by reviewed project policy. Make independently reviewed failing behavioural tests the default gate before implementation.

## Scope and acceptance

- Treat installation validation, bootstrap, reviewed policy, capability inventory and goal-DAG validation as shared invocation preconditions, not per-goal `context` phase evidence.
- Replace the shipped work phases with `understand`, `decompose`, `test_design`, `implement`, and `publish`. Children represent only independently deliverable, verifiable, prioritizable, blockable, or concurrently owned outcomes; they are never required merely to hold implementation. A goal without those children owns `test_design`, `implement`, verification, and publication itself. A parent is integration-only only while it has genuine implementation children. `understand` establishes requirements, viable design/architecture, and any user decisions; planning is normal agent work within `understand` and `test_design`, not a separate phase.
- Replace standalone `architecture_review`, `verify`, and final `review` nodes with declarative, per-work-phase review requirements. The default policy independently reviews `understand` and `test_design`, and selects review type, independence, model/effort, and human/root approval requirements by phase and consequence tier.
- Require `test_design` to produce failing behavioural tests before implementation. Its independent review must trace every goal acceptance behaviour to a test or an explicit justified exclusion; implementation cannot complete until all required tests pass.
- Retain integrated acceptance and entropy inspection as the required review of implementation evidence, configured as the `implement` phase review rather than a standalone phase.
- Define an execution skill/prompt and a review skill/prompt for each work phase. The CLI's next steps must reference the precise execution or review skill and must explicitly direct any delegation with the selected model-plus-effort pair.
- Bind each review record to the reviewed phase evidence and invalidate it when that evidence changes. Preserve byte-identical substantive outputs when reassessment confirms they remain valid.
- Update schema migration/adoption, public workflow dispatch, policy validation, tests, documentation, and prompt budgets together. Existing open goals become stale under the new policy; closed goals remain untouched until reopening.

## Verification

Use an end-to-end fixture through the public workflow command that demonstrates every work phase, its configured review gate, independently reviewed failing tests, complete behavioural-criterion coverage, implementation verification, stale-review invalidation, root-only human interaction, explicit routing, and final publication. Reject transitions that skip a required phase review or leave acceptance behaviour untested.
